# An article nobody reports as wrong is not theref

`customer_support.heu.self_service_deflection.an_article_nobody_reports_as_wrong_is_not_theref` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **heuristic**

> An article nobody reports as wrong is not therefore right.


## The heuristic

**An article nobody reports as wrong is not therefore right.**


_Why:_ Feedback on knowledge is catastrophically under-supplied — the misled customer leaves rather than complains, and the confused one assumes the fault is theirs. Silence on an article carries the same information as silence on an article nobody read, so freshness must be checked on a schedule and against releases rather than waited for.
